recent.text: Morez Johnson Jr. is questionable for Monday's game against the Indiana Pacers with a left shin/tibia contusion. He was not on Sunday's report. Tarik Biberović, Sergio De Larrea, and Dereck Lively II are out. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/vVjJRfpIJf

recent.text: The Dallas Mavericks are 6-2 with Kyrie Irving this season and 0-2 without him. Irving is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Indiana Pacers, the second night of a home back-to-back. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/ahQv0dHpQi

recent.text: Cooper Flagg set a career high with 12 assists, and six different Dallas Mavericks scored off his passes against Brooklyn. Dusty May said Flagg’s passing first impressed him. “I was shocked at how good of a passer he was.” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/q0kYDbYKFC
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: The Brooklyn Nets never led Sunday and shot 38.8% from the field, including 11-of-39 from three, in a 130-93 loss to the Dallas Mavericks. Dusty May graded Dallas’ scouting report discipline an “A-minus, B-plus.” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/NUp3o0G8oy
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Caleb Martin has started three of the Dallas Mavericks’ last four games, and Dallas outscored Brooklyn by 11 with him on the floor Sunday. Dusty May said Martin gives Dallas “the best chance to be elite defensively.” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/oHIpgSk51q
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Santi Aldama scored 12 points on 5-of-7 shooting in his second game with the Dallas Mavericks after March knee surgery. Dusty May has watched him since he was 17. “I didn’t realize he was a psycho competitor like he is.” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/If3MwI4FTj
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: No Dallas Mavericks player logged more than 29 minutes in a 130-93 win over Brooklyn, and three starters sat the fourth quarter. With Indiana visiting Monday, Dusty May said, “I’d love to do this every night if possible.” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/C2Jv9WjOxE
